description: Two hooks. PreToolUse/Bash refuses the one act in this atelier that cannot be undone by the agent that performs it: sending a person's recorded voice to a third party, or publishing a file the consent ledger marks as theirs. SessionStart prints the current reality — which held gates are open, and the reminder that hooks do not hot-swap. Neither hook blocks ordinary work: measuring, rendering, verifying and publishing the agent's own renders all pass untouched.
